fix_actions.root_cause: golangci-lint v1.65.0 binary has been removed from GitHub Releases; asset URL returns 404 (verified directly: curl -I https://github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/releases/download/v1.65.0/golangci-lint-1.65.0-linux-amd64.tar.gz -> HTTP/2 404). Other v1.x versions (v1.64.8, v1.63.4) and all v2.x still resolve (302 -> 200). Not transient.
fix_actions.fix: Pin golangci-lint-action to SHA 23faadfdeb23a6f9e511beaba149bb123b5b145a (v6.0.0 tag) and switch version v1.65.0 -> v1.64.8 (last available v1.x binary, same v1 config schema, same linters, no analysis-scope change).

fix_actions.root_cause: golangci-lint step failure caused subsequent steps in the same job to auto-skip. Single quality-gate job = single failure point masking build/unit/property results.
fix_actions.fix: Split quality-gate into independent jobs: go_lint, go_build_unit_property, go_vulnerability_scan. Each runs to completion regardless of sibling failures. quality-gate name preserved as a back-compat aggregator that reads split-job results.

evidence.back_compat_aggregator: quality-gate reads needs[].result and fails unless every split job is literal 'success'

fix_actions.root_cause: python-rh-tests step 5 (full pytest) exit 2 caused step 6 (entry-point subset) to auto-skip within the same job.
fix_actions.fix: Split entry-point subset into its own independent job python-rh-entry-points with no needs: dependency on python-rh-tests. Inject RH_RPC_PRIMARY/RH_RPC_SECONDARY/DATABASE_URL="" to validate no-send guards.

evidence.nodeid_subset: tests/ -k 'episode_persisted or daemon or reconciliation or graduation or readiness'

fix_actions.root_cause: go-redis/v9 v9.7.1 within GHSA-92cp-5422-2mw7 / CVE-2025-29923 vulnerable range (>=9.5.1).
fix_actions.fix: Minimal patch v9.7.1 -> v9.7.3 (last patched release in the v9.7.x line). API surface used by runtime.go (ParseURL/NewClient/Set/Ping/Close) verified drop-in compatible via new runtime_test.go.

fix_actions.root_cause: No explicit required aggregator — the original overall FAILURE mixed real failures, skipped steps, and downstream cancellations without distinguishing them.
fix_actions.fix: Add required-gate job with if: always() that reads needs[].result for every required component (go_lint, go_build_unit_property, go_vulnerability_scan, python-rh-tests, python-rh-entry-points) and only PASSES on literal 'success'. No continue-on-error on required path.
